paper_novelty_ceiling: A prospectively falsified transport proposal with robust task-specific sign reversal under semantically invariant interventions, independent scoring and replicated distinct task/mechanism/model families; no novelty in prompt sensitivity, ANOVA interactions, failure to generalize alone.

experiment.phase_0: Zero-call protocol and existing artifact custody/replay. Before paper result: verify historical condition labels, estimator compatibility, scorer parser, hosted seed semantics, missingness identity, and model version.
experiment.phase_1: Provider canary plus small precommitted 192-call instrumentation pilot, requiring successful P67 format-calibration prior to larger experiment. Do not use pilot for scientific p-values or model selection.
experiment.phase_2: Prospective 8192-call maximum main replication only after fixed go/no-go gate; no provider calls automatically and no partial adaptive scale-up.

models.availability: must be canary-verified; unavailable -> TECHNICAL_HOLD, not cherry-picked substitute

mechanism_examples: evidence transformation with independent invariance controls
experiment.vertex_definition: R×T (00,01,10,11) crossed with even-parity F/H/L nuisance contexts (000,011,101,110); preserves paired R and T comparisons within each nuisance context. The 16-vertex restricted design cannot estimate every 5-way cube interaction.
experiment.response_policy_note: Each provider uses two prospectively chosen, API-supported distinct output contracts; within-provider prompt text is byte-identical across contracts. Cross-provider decoder differences cannot be interpreted as matched API interventions.
experiment.pilot_identity: 2 hosted model bundles × 2 canary-only instances (provenance_0 and transformation_0, excluded from main 8 tasks) × 4 R/T vertices × 2 semantic twins × 2 response contracts × 3 repeats = 192 calls
experiment.provider_seeds: A numeric local draw label is not a model API seed unless request payload proves it. Log service response metadata and versions.
experiment.score: Two distinct observable all-call endpoints: answer_correct (u1/different or consistent abstention) and grounded_correct (answer plus EXACT one inclusion-minimal proof ID set); strict semantic_correct is legacy name for grounded_correct. Format-invalid responses have unobserved answer and grounding, not observed semantic error. Third-party blind human annotation required; internal two-module reference oracle is not external adjudication.
experiment.paper_primary_1: R/T operator marginal contrasts in matched nuisance contexts, task mechanism and model; evaluate sign reversal and transport under pre-frozen task-held-out predictions, with correction for within-task dependence.
experiment.paper_primary_2: LOFO Brier: For each held-out mechanism family, exclude both its task variants. Train representation deviations on the 6 remaining tasks; calibrate target-task intercept on FHL=000 anchors I,R,T,RT; predict 12 unseen vertices. Report per mechanism/model/channel paired Brier improvement over task-only anchor baseline. Four mechanism clusters are insufficient for strong universal inference.
experiment.secondary: Stopping-time replication only when calibrated sequential design is equivalent across response policies and provider models; otherwise stopping outcomes are historical only, not silently pooled.
planned_unimplemented_controls: actual behavioral model calls on 1152 offline retention-control packets (separate frozen allocation required)
genuinely blind human adjudication with private HMAC salt and private answer-key custody
P67 live paired-format feasibility and provider/model canaries
experiment.factory_instrument_definition: Current P69 source implements four hand-coded mechanism grammars with two parameterized variants each, NOT externally independently generated task ecologies. R consistently renames all identifiers, F adds unlinked filler, H reorders retained record rows, T reverses within-trace token positions, L reorders relation/rule rows. Full 5-way interaction not estimable on 16 vertices.
experiment.offline_retention_scope: 384 latent task×vertex×class cells with three public projections = 1152 model-visible packets; critical Rich/Coarse/Sham=1/0/0, recoverable 1/1/0, null 0/0/0. True latent decoy reserve, no false filler, equal rich/sham fact counts.
experiment.blind_external_scoring: Existing 72-case artifact in run 37783527335 is LABEL-OMITTED PREVIEW ONLY: public deterministic hashes are brute-force reversible because task×class×view candidates and source are public. For a real blinded third-party release, src/p69_blind_adjudication.py now requires an OFF-REPOSITORY >=32-byte secret-key HMAC supplied locally via --secret-file. The matching ground-truth key must remain in private custody; neither private key nor real secret is loaded into public GitHub Actions. No independent human annotation has yet occurred.

interpretation_gates.do_not_claim: No universal no-transport theorem or absence of causal effects from nonsignificant tests; no accuracy semantics from provider failure; no external generalization from eight synthetic instances alone.
interpretation_gates.artifact_kill: If semantic-neutral adjudication erases R/T sign reversals or cross-task transport failure, mark EVALUATION_ARTIFACT and do not publish intrinsic sensitivity claim.
interpretation_gates.family_kill: If a second independent model family does not reproduce sign inversion, report model/provider-bundle locality, not cross-model robustness.
interpretation_gates.ecology_kill: If held-out mechanism results can be predicted with cross-task operator structure, historical nontransport is not externally supported.
interpretation_gates.equivalence_kill: If any R/T edit changes the hidden task solution or target witness, discard that cell and mark protocol CONSTRUCT_HOLD; do not posthoc retarget oracle.
interpretation_gates.quality_gate: No main calls if canary/format pilot fails, and no per-model substitution selected by trial outcomes.
interpretation_gates.success: Evidence supports narrow replicated task-local representation-operator behavior even after scorer/format correction and out-of-family evaluation. Still no claim of general epistemic-infrastructure foreclosure.
interpretation_gates.inconclusive: Declare underpowered/inconsistent if confidence intervals and prediction differences do not resolve practical threshold.
interpretation_gates.construct_hold: P69 v2 offline scoring and retention-control tests pass but publication remains blocked by uncollected blinded external annotations, insufficiently independent hand-authored task worlds, uncalibrated provider response contracts and incomplete prospective clustered inference. Old 72-case public artifact is preview, not legitimate blinded trial.
interpretation_gates.no_transport_caution: Nonsignificant or nonpositive Brier improvements do NOT prove an impossibility of transport. Four clusters limit uncertainty estimation. To claim practical non-transport require a separately justified equivalence/noninferiority or predictive-loss margin test with external families.
